entries.subject: Archive access and query interface
entries.finding: NOIRLab's Astro Data Archive holds Blanco data under the telescope code ct4m and needs no account for public data. It publishes Simple Image Access rather than TAP; NOIRLab's separate Astro Data Lab does offer a TAP service for catalogues.
entries.revisitWhen: A body in this repository needs Blanco or DECam data.

entries.subject: Proprietary period, licence and credit
entries.finding: The proprietary period is usually 18 months, after which data are publicly accessible without an account. No reuse licence is published; the archive asks that its services be acknowledged. NOIRLab's own facility acknowledgement pages refuse this project's requests, so their wording is unverified.
entries.revisitWhen: This facility's data are used, or its terms are needed for a derived product.

entries.subject: Reduction software
entries.finding: DECam data are processed by NOIRLab's DECam Community Pipeline, documented in its public document library. No source distribution or licence is published for it.
entries.revisitWhen: Raw data from this facility are reduced here.
